name: Player_AccumulateUnitResourceRates
comment: Player resource accumulate tick (metal/energy make/use, cloak drain, extractor/wind/tidal/solar). FUN_=0  CALLER: Game_TickPlayersAndWatchMode when nUpdateTime<=dwGameTick;   then nUpdateTime+=0x1e (every 30 ticks). Gate: alive units, ctrl 1|2,   !endgame bit4, countdown<0.  UNIT GATE: dwFlags ALIVE 0x10000000. BUILDING 0x20000000 vs mobile.  ENERGY USE (UnitDef.flEnergyUse +0x1C6):   Building: ACTIVATION only. Mobile: ACTIVATION OR dwFlags&0xC (moving).   use>0 → flEnergyUse += use; if !stall → flEnergyUsePaid += use (bPaid).   use<0 → treated as make (negated); AI ctrl2 easy*0.5 med*0.7.  SPECIAL MAKE (building+ACTIVATION only; mutual-exclusive chain):   1) flExtractsMetal>0 && bPaid: flMetalMake += flExtractMetalRate(+0x58)      (Unit_UpdateExtractorMetalRate: Σ(bMetal+1)*flExtractsMetal)   2) else bMakesMetal && bPaid: flMetalMake += (float)bMakesMetal   3) else flWindGenerator>0: flEnergyMake += flWindFraction*flWindGenerator      (NO stall gate; Game_UpdateRandomWindState writes flWindFraction)   4) else flTidalGenerator>0: flEnergyMake += flTidalStrength*flTidalGenerator      (OTA tidalstrength via Mission_LoadOtaHeader)  SOLAR / STATIC MAKE (no separate solargenerator key):   When flBuildPercentLeft==0: flEnergyMake += UnitDef.flEnergyMake (FBI energymake);   flMetalMake += flMetalMake (FBI metalmake); sum flEnergy/MetalStorage into player.   Solar plants are plain energymake units — same path as fusion/etc.  STORAGE CAP:   Sum UnitDef.flEnergyStorage/flMetalStorage over completed units.   If bPlayerFlags&1: add flEnergy/MetalStorageBonus (Player_SetStartingStorageBonus,   clamp min 200). Amount = make+pool after settlement; overflow → dDbl*Wasted.  CLOAK (skip if nIsActive==0 OR bControllerType==3):   want=dwFlags bit11 0x800; block if holdoff 0x1000 OR dwGameTick<dwCloakHoldoffTick(+0xB0).   Cost: (dwFlags&0xC)? flCloakCostMoving(+0x1DE):flCloakCost(+0x1DA); __ftol.   If flEnergyAmount(+0x8C)>=cost: deduct, flEnergyUse+=cost, CLOAKED=1; else 0.   Unit_SetActivateState(unit, CLOAKED=4, bSet).  AI SCALE (ctrl==2 / bControllerType@+0x73): easy*0.5 med*0.7 hard*1.0 on makes.  SETTLE: pay stall then usePaid fractions from make+amount; write income/usage;   reset per-unit slots; fold pAiResourceSlot.

name: MissionTick_MakeSelectable
signature: uint MissionTick_MakeSelectable(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MAKESELECTABLE mission tick. Table MissionOrder_MakeSelectable @004fc607: lookup "MakeSelectable", flags=0x4. Script: S/s → FindByName("MAKESELECTABLE"); also auto-appended by Mission_ParseScriptOrderString when InitialMission lacks D/S/P/A-coords.  FUN_=0 Sets unit.dwFlags bit0x20 (OR ECX,0x20), clears bit0x8000 (AND CH,0x7f). Always ret 5.  dwFlags bit0x8000 = CONFIRMED SOFT:   CLEAR: only here (AND CH,0x7f after MOV ECX,[unit+0x110]).   SET: no runtime OR/imm setter (no OR EAX/mem,0x8000; no OR CH,0x80;        no OR byte [unit+0x111],0x80). Save/Load round-trip only        (GameSave_SaveUnits pack bits>=14<<6; LoadUnitById        (packed>>6)&0x8000).   READ: no TEST [unit+0x110],0x8000; no TEST byte [unit+0x111],0x80        (those hits are WeaponDef.PARALYZER via pWeapon+0x111).   Do not name.

name: MissionTick_Wait
signature: uint MissionTick_Wait(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: WAIT mission tick. Table MissionOrder_Wait @004fc620: display "Waiting", lookup "Wait", flags=0x4. Script: W/w + "%f %d" → FindByName("WAIT"); nParam0=ticks (scaled), nParam1=radius.  Mode A — nParam1!=0 (radius wait):   Ai_CollectVisibleUnitsInRadius(unit.side, unit.pos, nParam1).   any enemy OR nParam0<1 → ret 5 (done).   else nParam0 -= RandMod(0x1e)+0x96; Mission_SetDeadlineTicks(that); ret 2. Mode B — nParam1==0 (timed wait):   phase0: Mission_SetDeadlineTicks(nParam0) → ret 1.   phase1: ret 5 (deadline fired).   else: ret 7.

name: MissionTick_AttackUType
signature: uint MissionTick_AttackUType(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: ATTACKUTYPE. Table @004fc652 display "Attacking", lookup AttackUType, pfnSecondary=0, drawMask=0, flags=4. Script InitialMission 'A' + unitdef name (Mission_ParseScriptOrderString).  Phases:  0: require CANATTACK; Mission_SetDeadlineTicks(1+RandMod(0x5a)) →1; else ret7.  1: scan g_GameState unit array for wUnitDefIndex==nParam0 and aAllyFlags[target]==0; pick min jittered distSq (distSq - RandMod(distSq/2)); if none ret5. Resolve OrderIntent_Attack vs target, Construct+LinkOrderIntoChain attack order → ret0.  else ret7.

name: MissionTick_WaitForAttack
signature: uint MissionTick_WaitForAttack(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: WAITFORATTACK mission tick. Table MissionOrder_WaitForAttack @004fc639: display "Waiting for attack", lookup "WaitForAttack", flags=0x204. Script: Wa/WA + unit name → FindByName("WAITFORATTACK"); attaches target via PathOrderAttach.  If attach.pAttachedUnit==0 → ret 5 (done/abort). phase0: dwStateFlags=0x18 (same wake bits used with deadlines elsewhere) → ret 1. phase1: ret 5. else: ret 7. Leaf — no callees; phase advance relies on dispatcher wake of flags 0x18.

name: MissionTick_SelfDestruct
signature: uint MissionTick_SelfDestruct(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Mission order handler for SelfDestruct AND SelfDestructFG (same pfnTick).  Table: MissionOrder_SelfDestruct @004fc58a (byte+0x10=0x13, flags dword@+0x11=0x40040); MissionOrder_SelfDestructFG @004fc5a3 (flags 0). Lookup names SelfDestruct / SelfDestructFG; display "SELF DESTRUCT ENGAGED".  Countdown: UnitDef.dwCanDoFlags SELFDESTRUCTCOUNTDOWN_MASK 0x700000 >>20 &7 (default FBI missing → 5) stored in MissionOrder.nParam1 | 0xF0000000. g_abSpeechTypeTable IDs by remaining count BEFORE dec:   rem 5→0x11 count5/five, 4→0x12 count4, 3→0x13, 2→0x14, 1→0x15, 0→0x16 count0. Between steps: Mission_SetDeadlineTicks(0x1E); final (rem==0): RandMod(0xF) then nParam0=1. Cancel: wakeFlags&2 during countdown → return 5; speech 0x17 canceldestruct unless unit.dwFlags&0x4000 (dying/silent).  Detonate when nParam0!=0 OR countdown mask==0: Unit_ApplyDamageAndBroadcast(self,self,30000,damageKind=3) → bLastDamageType=3, dying 0x4000 → Unit_TickAllPlayersScriptsAndWeapons → BroadcastKilledPacket(killType=3) → pkt+10 hi nibble 0x30 → Unit_DetonateExplodeAsOrSelfDestruct(..., bSelfDestruct=1) → UnitDef.pSelfDestructAsWeapon (TDF selfdestructas).  FG/script 'D': Mission_ParseScriptOrderString → SELFDESTRUCTFG with nParam0=1 → skip countdown. Ctrl+D: Game_HandleBattleHotkeys 0xAD toggles via Unlink vs Unit_IssueOrdersToSelected. Also enqueued by MissionTick_Attack_Kamikaze (approach done) and MissionTick_Standby_Mine.

name: MissionTick_Attack_NoMove
signature: uint MissionTick_Attack_NoMove(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: ATTACK_NOMOVE. Table @004fc4a9 display "Attacking", lookup Attack_NoMove, pfnSecondary=DrawAttackAnim, drawMask=8, flags=0x280. Orders_Resolve Attack→ATTACK_NOMOVE when unit has no pMotion (*pUnit==0) and dwFlags bit29 (0x20000000).  Abort: !attach.pAttachedUnit || wake&0x10808 → ret5. Phases:  0: Announce →1.  1: DeactivateWeaponSlot(0); Weapon_SetAimTargetUnit(attach, slot0); dwStateFlags=0x11808 →1.  2: ActivateWeaponSlot(3) → ret9 (done/hold).  else ret7. No approach goals (stationary vs Attack_Chase).

name: MissionTick_Guard_NoMove
signature: uint MissionTick_Guard_NoMove(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: GUARD_NOMOVE (table @004fc66f lookup Guard_NoMove). Stationary area guard — NOT player CANGUARD (that is Follow_Ground).  Wake&0x10008 → force phase3 (rescan). Phases:  0: ActivateWeaponSlot(3); deadline 0x1e →1  1: PathOrderAttach_LinkToUnit(aimTarget); if alive(ALIVE 0x10000000): copy pos, DeactivateWeaponSlot(0), Weapon_SetAimTargetUnit, nParam0=0, nParam1=3+RandMod(3) →2; else deadline 0x1e ret2  2: hold-fire: wake&0x4000 clears nParam0 else ++; if nParam0<=nParam1 && Weapon_IsTargetInRange → dwStateFlags|=0x7008 ret2 (IN-PLACE engage; NO Unit_IssueAttackOrder). Else 50% retick nParam0=0 ret1 else ret0  3: Ai_CollectVisibleUnitsInRadius(side, order.nPos, r=0x280); pick Rand enemy; Attach+Aim; bPhase=1 ret2 Else ret7.  Attack handoff: weapon-aim + state 0x7008 (vs Patrol/Standby/Follow which prepend Attack via Unit_IssueAttackOrder).

name: MissionTick_SelfRepair
signature: uint MissionTick_SelfRepair(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: SELFREPAIR mission tick. pUnit=heal target; attach.pAttachedUnit=BUILDER worker. Abort: attach==0 → speech Repair_aborted ret8. P0: require worker BUILDER; require target ACTIVATION && flBuildPercentLeft==0; else ret8; DeactivateWeaponSlot(3)→1. P1: if HP>=Max→1; else cloakHoldoff=tick+0x96; ApplyRepairHealProgress(worker,target,WorkerTime/30); nano QueryNanoPiece+Fx_SpawnStartTickEffect(...,6); deadline1|8→2. P2: speech Unit_repaired→5. vs RepairUnit: SelfRepair is passive on target with attached builder; RepairUnit is worker-driven approach/repair of attach target. vs VTOL_GetRepaired: SelfRepair applies heal; GetRepaired only waits.

name: MissionTick_BuildingBuild
signature: uint MissionTick_BuildingBuild(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: BuildingBuild (factory). P0: attach; factory flag 0x20000000 → Activate if queue>0. P1: WaitIfUnitNotReady(2). P2: QueryBuildInfo piece pos; CanPlace; CreateFromDefId; XOR-copy standing orders from   factory dwFlags: bits[19:18] mask 0xc0000 (StandingMove) and bits[21:20] mask 0x300000   (StandingFire) — NOT UnitTypeFlags FLOATER/UPRIGHT; enqueue getbuilt; Activate(8). P3: ApplyBuildProgressDelta(WorkerTime/30)+nano FX6. P4: speech; Activate(8,0); FinalizeBuiltUnit; queue--. Cancel&2: metal refund (1-build%)*MetalCost (AI*0.5/0.7); Finalize; damage 30000 type9; Activate(9,0). FUN_=0

name: MissionTick_BuildWeapon
signature: uint MissionTick_BuildWeapon(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Algorithm:   Stockpile charge builder (order BUILDWEAPON).   nParam0=weapon slot; nParam1=charges left; nParam2=progress 0..nReloadTime.   Phase0: need nParam1>0; if bStockpile>=200 wait 300t; else nParam2=0 → phase1.   Phase1: progress+=5 (cap reload); pay proportional E/M per shot via AddUseIfNotStalled; stall→10t else incomplete→5t; done→phase2.   Phase2: bStockpile++; nParam1--; UpdateBuildMenuIfFocusUnit; return 0 (re-enter).   Cap 200. Cost = full flEnergy/MetalPerShot over nReloadTime ticks.  Parameters:   pUnit, pOrder, dwWakeFlags  Returns:   mission status (0/1/2/5/7)  Note: Issue via Gui_IssueBuildMenuOrder MAKENUKE|MAKEANTI. Consume in ProcessWeaponSlots (STOCKPILE).

name: MissionTick_Paralyze
signature: uint MissionTick_Paralyze(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: PARALYZE mission tick (table @ 004fc5c0; name "paralyze").  Damage entry (not an OrderIntent): Unit_ApplyNetDamagePacket kind==2   <- Unit_ApplyDamageAndBroadcast <- Weapon_ApplyScaledDamageToTarget   damageType = ((WeaponFlags.PARALYZER bit7)+1) => 1=normal, 2=paralyze. TDF: WeaponDef "paralyzer"; UnitDef "immunetoparalyzer" => IMMUNETOPARALYZER bit26. Gates: unit alive (0x10000000), not dying (0x4000), owner active human/AI (ctrl 1|2), !IMMUNETOPARALYZER. Stack: if head mission already paralyze => nParam0 += amount; else Construct(paralyze, nParam0=amount) + Link.  Phases (via Unit_ProcessPrimaryMissionOrders + deadline bit0): A) Setup (nParam0!=0): cap nParam0 at 0x708 (1800 ticks); DeactivateWeaponSlot(3=all);    ResetWeaponAimTarget slots 0..2; SetAttachedFx(null); Mission_SetDeadlineTicks(nParam0);    nParam0=0; Unit_SetActivateState(PARALYZED=0x10, set); ret 1 (++phase).    Dispatcher then waits on dwStateFlags bit0 until dwDeadlineTick. B) Clear (nParam0==0 on deadline re-entry): Unit_SetActivateState(PARALYZED, clear); ret 5 (done).    If more kind-2 damage arrived during wait, nParam0>0 again => re-Setup (extend).  COB: SetActivateState does NOT call a Paralyze script (only Activate/Deactivate/Start|StopBuilding/cloak speech). Targeting: PARALYZER weapons skip already-PARALYZED targets (Unit_FindBestTargetInRange; Ai_UpdateWeaponTargetsTick).

name: MissionTick_GetBuilt
signature: uint MissionTick_GetBuilt(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: GetBuilt (unit under construction). While flBuildPercentLeft!=0: P0→deadline 300; P1→deadline 30; P2: if wake&1 ApplyUnfinishedBuildDecay(self,11); flags|=0x8000. On complete (build%==0): copy builder QMove/QPatrol as Move/Patrol; XOR-sync standing   move/fire from builder (dwFlags masks 0xc0000 / 0x300000 — StandingMove/StandingFire,   not FLOATER/UPRIGHT) + AI group slot; else enqueue default mission. Done5. FUN_=0

name: MissionTick_BeCarried
signature: uint MissionTick_BeCarried(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Passenger while carried (MissionOrder_BeCarried). Enqueued only via Mission_HandleBeCarried after transport attach (skipped if carrier ISAIRBASE). Phase0: Unit_DeactivateWeaponSlot(all=3) ret1. Phase1: Mission_SetDeadlineTicks(10) ret2. Else phase ret7. pCarrier==0 ret5. vs Park: BeCarried=cargo attach lifecycle; Park=idle hold / air morph to VTOL_MOVE.

name: MissionTick_Activate
signature: uint MissionTick_Activate(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: ACTIVATE mission tick. Table MissionOrder_Activate @004fc4c2: lookup "Activate", flags=0x10060. If UnitDef.dwCanDoFlags ONOFFABLE (bit2): Unit_SetActivateState(unit, ACTIVATION=1, bSet=1) → Cob Activate + speech type3. Always ret 5. UI: Gui_HandleStandingOrderGadgets STATUS|ONOFF → "ACTIVATE". Also: CreateFromDefId ACTIVATEWHENBUILT (UnitTypeFlags bit18); Cob SET ACTIVATION; UnitMotion_SetActivateMode for VTOL land/takeoff. FUN_=0

name: MissionTick_Deactivate
signature: uint MissionTick_Deactivate(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: DEACTIVATE mission tick. Table MissionOrder_Deactivate @004fc4db. If ONOFFABLE: Unit_SetActivateState(unit, ACTIVATION=1, bSet=0) → Cob Deactivate + speech4. Always ret 5. FUN_=0

name: MissionTick_Cloak_On
signature: uint MissionTick_Cloak_On(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Mission order Cloak_On: if UnitDef.dwCanDoFlags CANCLOAK_FROM_COST (bit13/0x2000), set UnitInstance.dwFlags bit11 0x800 (want-cloak).  UI: Gui_HandleStandingOrderGadgets CLOAK gadget → MissionOrder_FindByName("CLOAK_ON") → Unit_IssueOrdersToSelected; capability bits[4:3]. Dispatched from Unit_ProcessPrimaryMissionOrders during Unit_TickAllPlayersScriptsAndWeapons.  Actual cloak is UnitActivateFlags.CLOAKED (bit2/0x4) applied in Player_AccumulateUnitResourceRates after energy/holdoff (not this tick). INIT_CLOAKED (UnitTypeFlags bit4) also seeds want via InitInstanceFields (<<7). Returns 5 (complete). FUN_=0

name: MissionTick_Cloak_Off
signature: uint MissionTick_Cloak_Off(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Mission order Cloak_Off: if CANCLOAK_FROM_COST, clear UnitInstance.dwFlags bit11 0x800. UI twin of Cloak_On via Gui_HandleStandingOrderGadgets ("CLOAK_OFF"). Next resource tick → SetActivateState(CLOAKED,0) when want clear. Returns 5 (complete). FUN_=0

name: MissionTick_Standing_MoveOrder
signature: uint MissionTick_Standing_MoveOrder(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: STANDING_MOVEORDER tick (table Standing_MoveOrder / STANDING_MOVEORDER). FUN_=0  Pack: unit.dwFlags bits[19:18] = (order.nParam0 & 3) << 18;   clear mask 0xfff3ffff. StandingMoveOrder: 0=HOLD 1=MANEUVER 2=ROAM.   Bit values on dwFlags: HOLD=0, MANEUVER=0x40000, ROAM=0x80000. Return 5 (complete).  Issue path: Gui_HandleStandingOrderGadgets MOVEORD → stack nParam0=next   (HOLD→1, MANEUVER→2, ROAM|MIXED_UI→0) + FindByName(STANDING_MOVEORDER)   → Unit_IssueOrdersToSelected(intent=0) → MissionOrder_EnqueueOnUnit.   Panel mirror: wOrdersCapabilityBits[2:0]; gate MOBILESTANDORDERS. Init: Unit_InitInstanceFields copies UnitTypeFlags STANDINGMOVEORDER_MASK<<18   (FBI standingmoveorder default 2=ROAM). Script OTA 'O': Mission_ParseScriptOrderString sets bits18-21 from %d %d. Cob GET id2 STANDINGMOVEORDERS; SET is dirty-only (no write).  Consumers of bits[19:18]:   Unit_IssueAttackOrder — HOLD+!explicit→0; MANEUVER+!explicit→Move+Attack leash     (nManeuverLeashLength); else Attack direct.   MissionOrder_EnqueueRepairWithStandingMove — HOLD→Move+Repair(sight);     MANEUVER→Move+Repair(leash); ROAM→Repair only.   Factory spawn: BuildingBuild/GetBuilt XOR-copy 0xc0000 from builder.   Gui_RefreshOrdersAndBuildFromSelection packs >>18&3 into capability bits.

name: MissionTick_Standing_FireOrder
signature: uint MissionTick_Standing_FireOrder(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: STANDING_FIREORDER tick (table Standing_FireOrder / STANDING_FIREORDER). FUN_=0  Pack: unit.dwFlags bits[21:20] = (order.nParam0 & 3) << 20;   clear mask 0xffcfffff. StandingFireOrder: 0=HOLD_FIRE 1=RETURN_FIRE 2=FIRE_AT_WILL.   Bit values: HOLD_FIRE=0, RETURN_FIRE=0x100000, FIRE_AT_WILL=0x200000. If nParam0==0|1 (HOLD_FIRE|RETURN_FIRE): ResetWeaponAimTarget on slots with bFlags&0x10. Return 5.  Issue path: Gui_HandleStandingOrderGadgets FIREORD → nParam0=next   (HOLD_FIRE→1, RETURN→2, FIRE_AT_WILL|MIXED→0) + FindByName(STANDING_FIREORDER)   → Unit_IssueOrdersToSelected. Panel: wOrdersPanelFlags[14:12]; gate FIRESTANDORDERS. Init: UnitTypeFlags STANDINGFIREORDER_MASK(0xC)<<18 → bits20-21 (FBI standingfireorder default 2). Cob GET id3 STANDINGFIREORDERS; SET dirty-only.  Consumers of bits[21:20]:   Unit_FindBestTargetIfFireAtWill — only ==0x200000 seeks (Standby/Patrol/SeekAttack).   Unit_IssueAttackOrder — HOLD_FIRE+!explicit→0.   Unit_RetargetAttack / Follow_Ground — !=0 enables per-slot Weapon_SetAimTargetUnit.   Ai_UpdateWeaponTargetsTick — eligibility requires ==0x200000.   AirStrike/AirTo* abort→VTOL_SEEKATTACK if (dwFlags&0x300000)!=0 (not HOLD_FIRE).   Standby_Mine — seek + !=0 + target footprintFlags==1 → SELFDESTRUCT.   BuildingBuild/GetBuilt XOR-copy 0x300000 from builder (standing fire, NOT FLOATER/UPRIGHT).

name: MissionTick_QMove
signature: uint MissionTick_QMove(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Shared pfnTick for QMOVE and QPATROL table entries. FUN_=0  Body: MissionOrder_SetDeadlineTicks(pOrder, 0x3c); return 6 (hold/wait). Real MOVE/PATROL substituted elsewhere when builder GetBuilt copies queued QMove/QPatrol as OrderIntent_Move/Patrol (see MissionTick_GetBuilt). Leaf wrapper — not a path FSM.

name: MissionTick_AttackSpecial
signature: uint MissionTick_AttackSpecial(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: ATTACKSPECIAL (Blast intent). Table @004fc797 display "Annihilating", lookup AttackSpecial, pfnSecondary=DrawAttackAnim, drawMask=8, flags=0x680.  Not a combat FSM: Orders_ResolveMissionNameFromIntent(OrderIntent_Attack, attached unit) → MissionOrder_MergeFlagsFromTable(resolved type); forces nParam0=2 (special weapon slot). Rewrites this order into ATTACK_CHASE / ATTACK_NOMOVE / SUPPRESS / air / kamikaze as Attack would pick. Orders_Resolve: OrderIntent_Blast → ATTACKSPECIAL when unitdef CanDo bit14.

name: MissionTick_Move_Ground
signature: uint MissionTick_Move_Ground(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MOVE_GROUND mission tick. Table lookup Move_Ground (ground Move intent). FUN_=0  Abort phase0 if pCarrier!=0 (ret7) — cannot path while cargo. nParam0 = approach radius base; goal radius = nParam0+4.  Phases:  0: AnnounceStatusIfFlagged; MissionOrder_AttachApproachRadiusGoal(order.nPos, nParam0+4);     dwStateFlags=0xe0 (path/approach wake) → ret1.  1: wake&0x20 (arrived) → Unit_QueueSpeech(id=6) ret5 (done);     else ret9 (hold while approaching). Else ret7.  Thin path FSM vs VTOL_Move (air takeoff/PathOrder/cruiseAlt).

name: MissionTick_Attack_Kamikaze
signature: uint MissionTick_Attack_Kamikaze(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Attack_Kamikaze mission tick. Selected when OrderIntent_Attack and UnitDef.dwUnitTypeFlags KAMIKAZE (bit28 / 0x10000000). Table: MissionOrder_Attack_Kamikaze @004fc77e — display "Attacking", lookup "Attack_Kamikaze", pfnSecondary=MissionOrder_DrawAttackAnim, drawMask=8, flags=0x600.  Radius: UnitDef.nKamikazeDistance (+0x218); clamped min 0x10. Also drawn by Gfx_DrawUnitRangeOverlays labeled kamikazedistance.  Phases:  0: Abort if pCarrier!=0 (ret 7). Announce if flagged. AttachApproachRadiusGoal     (order pos; attached-unit pos synced each tick), deadline=0x3c, stateFlags|=0xe0 →1.  1: wake&0x10008 → ret 5 (cancel/abort).     wake&0x20 (approach reached): Unit_QueueSpeech(unit,6,0) then     MissionOrder_Construct(SELFDESTRUCT, nParam0=1) + LinkOrderIntoChain → ret 5.     wake&0x40 → ret 8 (path fail).     else reset bPhase=0, ret 2 (re-approach). Else ret 7.  nParam0=1 skips SD countdown → immediate Unit_ApplyDamageAndBroadcast(kind=3) → pSelfDestructAsWeapon.

name: MissionTick_Patrol
signature: uint MissionTick_Patrol(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: PATROL (string Patrol/Patrolling). Orders_Resolve OrderIntent_Patrol + CANPATROL(0x40): ground Patrol; CANFLY→VTOL_Patrol; +CANREPAIR→RepairPatrol; *pMotion==0→QPatrol.  Phases:  0: require pMotion else ret7; Announce; MissionOrder_EnsurePatrolReturnOrder (append same-type order at unit pos + flag 0x8000 ping-pong partner); deadline 1 →1  1: ActivateWeaponSlot(3); AttachApproachRadiusGoal(order.nPos,r=0); deadline 0xf; dwStateFlags|=0xe0 →2  2: wake&0xe0 → phase1 ret6; else Unit_FindBestTargetIfFireAtWill + Unit_IssueAttackOrder(explicit=0) → clear flags, phase1, ret3 (ATTACK HANDOFF); else deadline=0x1e+RandMod(0x1e), phase1, ret4 Else ret7.  Loop = MissionOrder queue ping-pong (flags 0x8000), not PathGoal waypoint advance.

name: MissionTick_Attack_Chase
signature: uint MissionTick_Attack_Chase(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: ATTACK_CHASE. Table @004fc765 display "Attacking", lookup Attack_Chase, pfnSecondary=DrawAttackAnim, drawMask=8, flags=0x280. Orders_Resolve Attack→ATTACK_CHASE when pMotion!=0 (mobile ground).  Abort: wake&0x800 || !attach || wake&0x10008 →5. Optional leash: if nParam2!=0 and Hypot(unit-nData0)>=nParam2 →5. Phases:  0: require pMotion && !CANFLY && dwFlags&0x80000000; Announce; stash unit pos; nParam1=0; if nParam0==0 set nParam0=Unit_GetFirstReadyWeaponSlot →1.  1: clear attached Fx; wake&0x3000→1; if !Weapon_IsTargetInRange→1; else Deactivate slots 0+2, SetAimTargetUnit, flags=0x13808 →2.  2: approach state machine via nParam1 (0..8): ApproachRadius (full/half range), altitude gate→nParam1=6, lateral circle offset, RingApproach (range, range/2) then (2*range, range) cycling nParam1.  3: wake&0x40e0→phase1 ret4; if in range aim+flags 0x148e8 deadline 0x1e→2; else ActivateWeaponSlot(3), flags 0x100e8, deadline 0x1e→2.  else ret7.

name: MissionTick_Suppress
signature: uint MissionTick_Suppress(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: SUPPRESS (ground fire-at-position). Table @004fc74c display "Suppressing fire", lookup Suppress, pfnSecondary=DrawAttackAnim, drawMask=8, flags=0x410. Orders_Resolve Attack→SUPPRESS when pUnit[0x44]<0 (immobile path) && !enemy-target path && !CANFLY && primary weapon lacks bit17.  wake&0x800→5. Phases:  0: CANFLY→8; Announce; nParam1=Weapon_GetRangeFromSlot(nParam0) →1.  1: if nParam0==2: Deactivate slot3, aim slot2 at nPos; else Deactivate 0+1, aim slots 0+1 at nPos; flags=0x1c00 →1.  2: ActivateWeaponSlot(3); wake&0x400→phase1 ret6; if pMotion && nParam1>=1: AttachApproachRadiusGoal(nPos,nParam1), flags=0xe0, shrink nParam1 by RandMod(range/3), phase=1 →4; else→9.  else→7. Diff vs Chase/NoMove: aims order.nPos (not attach unit); nParam0 is weapon-slot (2=special from AttackSpecial rewrite).

name: MissionTick_MobileBuild
signature: uint MissionTick_MobileBuild(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MobileBuild (ground builder). Cancel&8→speech+HUD ret8; &2→HUD done5.  Params: nParam0=unitDefId; nPosX/Y/Z=site (Y height); nParam2=CanPlace retry; attach.pAttachedUnit=under-construction unit (CreateFromDefId EAX→PathOrder_AttachToUnit).  P0: snap X/Z to footprint cells; AttachBuildFootprintMarker; nParam2=0; dwStateFlags=0xe0. P1: if &0x40 BuildDistance check (hypot worker−site − footprints); Map_CanPlaceUnitFootprint(mode1);   fail: speech; nParam2++ ≤10 deadline 0x1e else cancel8.   ok: DeactivateWeaponSlot(3); SnapWorldPosToFootprint; CreateFromDefId(owner,def,pos,bFinished=0,footprintFlags=1);   attach built; enqueue getbuilt(queue) on built with builder attach; StartBuildingScript(relHeading); ret1.   attach fail: speech deadline300 ret2. P2: WaitIfUnitNotReady(10) — unit+0x10f bit0. P3: ApplyBuildProgressDelta(WorkerTime/30); nano FX slot6; cloakHoldoff=tick+300; |10 deadline1 until build%==0. P4: speech → done5.

name: MissionTick_HelpBuild
signature: uint MissionTick_HelpBuild(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: HelpBuild (assist construction). Req: BUILDER+pMotion; attach=target under construction. Cancel wake&2→HUD dirty done5; lost attach→Construction_terminated ret8. P0: ring approach BuildDistance + halfApprox(hypot footprints); state|=0xe8→1. P1: wake&0x40→can't get there ret8; if Build%==0→5; else Deactivate3+StartBuilding+HUD→1. P2: WaitIfNotInBuildStance(flags=10). P3: ApplyBuildProgressDelta(worker,target,WorkerTime/30); nano FX type6; cloak+300; if Build%!=0 deadline1|10→2 else→1. P4: speech Building_complete; state|=2→5. Heal path is NOT used — construction uses ApplyBuildProgressDelta (HP from build%), not kind10.

name: MissionTick_Capture
signature: uint MissionTick_Capture(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MissionTick_Capture — CAPTURE order (CANCAPTURE dwCanDoFlags bit12 0x1000). Target: attach.pAttachedUnit. Entry fail if target==0 or wake&0x10008 → speech7 "Capture failed" ret8.  PHASES (bPhase switch): P0 init: need pMotion + worker CANCAPTURE. Reject target CANCAPTURE→speech7 cannot_be_captured ret8.   Reject flBuildPercentLeft!=0 → speech7 cloud_of_vapor ret8.   AnnounceStatusIfFlagged("Capturing").   nParam1 duration ticks:     base=ftol(flBuildCostEnergy*0.015 + flBuildCostMetal*0.2142857 + 150); clamp<=0x708(1800);     *= (nHitPoints+dwMaxDamage)/(2*dwMaxDamage);     *= ((wKillCount/5)+10)/10;   // asm: *10/100   DeactivateWeaponSlot(3); AttachBuildFootprintMarker(target cell/foot);   dwStateFlags=0x100e8; ret1. P1 approach: wake&0x40 → ret8. Else if hypot(delta)-ftol(hypot(workerFoot)*8)+ftol(hypot(targetFoot)*(-8))   <= nBuildDistance: StartBuilding(headingRel); ret1. Else ret0. P2: MissionOrder_WaitIfNotInBuildStance(wakeFlags=0x10008) →1 advance /2 wait. P3: Unit_QueueSpeech(worker, 0xB working, NULL); ret1. P4 nano: if target.pMotion && (dwFlags&0xC): StopBuilding; deadline=0x1e; ret0 (abort move).   else if nParam0 < nParam1: QueryNanoPiece; Fx_SpawnStartTickEffect_BoundsThenOrigin(targetAABB,nano,6);     cloakHoldoff=gameTick+900; nParam0+=2; deadline=2; ret2.   else ret1. P5 done: Unit_TransferOwnership(target, worker->pOwnerPlayer, NULL);   Unit_QueueSpeech(worker, 0x10 capture, NULL); ret5. default ret7.  Speech map (Unit_QueueSpeech nSpeechType): 7=cant, 0xB=11 working, 0x10=16 capture. Transfer: damage kind4 wipe path inside Unit_TransferOwnership; no VTOL_Capture mission. Contrast: ReclaimUnit uses damage kind5; Unit_CanReclaimTarget excludes CANCAPTURE.

name: MissionTick_ReclaimUnit
signature: uint MissionTick_ReclaimUnit(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MissionTick_ReclaimUnit — unit reclaim (ground). FUN_=0  Target: attach.pAttachedUnit. Abort if null or wake&0x10008 →5. Gate P0: pMotion+CANRECLAMATE + Unit_CanReclaimTarget (target dwFlags&3!=2, !CANCAPTURE). Announce "Reclaiming"; DeactivateWeaponSlot(3).  Phases:  1 AttachBuildFootprintMarker; |0x100e8; deadline15;    nParam0=Unit_ComputeReclaimDamagePulse(worker,target,15); nParam1=0  2 StartBuilding toward target (pathfail&0x40→9)  3 WaitIfNotInBuildStance(wake 0x10008)  4 speech 0xb  5 In BuildDistance^2 (+target modelAvgSize/2): if CanReclaimTarget,    every nParam1>14 ApplyDamageAndBroadcast(dmg, kind=5); nParam1=0;    cloakHoldoff=tick+900; nano BoundsThenOrigin slot6; deadline2; nParam1+=2; ret2    else StopBuilding; deadline15; ret0  Metal return on kill: HandleKilled hi-nibble 0x50 → attacker flMetalMake +=   (1-build%)*BuildCostMetal (AI easy*0.5 med*0.7). BroadcastKilled: killType5 →   cobSeverity=0 wreckageLevel=0 (no corpse).

name: MissionTick_Reclaim
signature: uint MissionTick_Reclaim(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MissionTick_Reclaim — feature reclaim (ground). FUN_=0  Gate: Map_GetFeatureIdAtWorldPos; FEATURE_RECLAIMABLE (FeatureDef.wFlags bit7). Req P0: pMotion + UnitDef.dwCanDoFlags CANRECLAMATE (bit10 / AH&4).  Phases:  0 AttachBuildFootprintMarker; dwStateFlags=0xe0; ret1  1 if wake&0x40 fail8; else nParam0=ftol(15+0.5*(flEnergy+flMetal))    [asm: (E+M)*-0.5 FSUBR 15.0 @4fc940/4fc944]; StartBuilding toward feature  2 WaitIfNotInBuildStance  3 speech 0xb; fallthru 4  4 deadline2; nParam0-=2; if>0: cloakHoldoff=tick+300;    if nParam0>15: QueryNanoPiece + 2x Fx_SpawnNanoBeamEffect_BoundsThenOrigin(slot6);    ret2 else ret1  5 Feature_ApplyReclaimYield(worldPos); ret5 done  Fail: no feature/not reclaimable→8; no motion/CANRECLAMATE→7.

name: MissionTick_Resurrect
signature: uint MissionTick_Resurrect(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: MissionTick_Resurrect — feature→unit resurrect. FUN_=0  Gate: CANRESURRECT (dwCanDoFlags bit11 / CH&8); FEATURE_RECLAIMABLE. Fail no feature→"Resurrection failed"8; not reclaimable→8.  Phases:  0 AttachBuildFootprintMarker; dwStateFlags=0xe0  1 StartBuilding at feature (pathfail&0x40→8)  2 WaitIfNotInBuildStance  3 Truncate FeatureDef.aName at '_'; UnitDef_FindIdByName → nParam0    nParam1=ftol(BuildTime*0.3/(WorkerTime/30))=ftol(BuildTime*9/WorkerTime)    [asm: FILD BuildTime@+0x1ea; FMUL 0.3d@4fc948; FDIV WorkerTime/30]; speech 0xb    unknown UnitDef→"Ressurection failed"8  4 nParam1--; if!=0: QueryNanoPiece; Fx_SpawnNanoBeamEffect(slot6);    cloakHoldoff=tick+300; deadline1; ret2 else fallthru→ret1  5 Unit_CreateFromDefId(owner, nParam0, order pos); LinkToUnit attach    copy FeatureAnim turns→pitch/heading/bank; Map_RemoveFeatureFromCell;    net pkt 0x0F/0xFF if provider3; flBuildPercentLeft=0; nHitPoints=1; HUD dirty  6 speech "Resurrection complete"; Orders_ResolveMissionNameFromIntent(Repair);    Prepend repair MissionOrder; ret5  Build progress: resurrect work uses nParam1 countdown (not flBuildPercentLeft). Created unit starts Build%=0 HP=1 then queued Repair finishes it.

name: MissionTick_RepairUnit
signature: uint MissionTick_RepairUnit(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: RepairUnit (worker-driven). Req: worker BUILDER+pMotion; target Build%==0, dwFlags&3==1. Optional leash: if nParam2!=0 and hypot(mapXZ delta)>nParam2 → done5. P0: announce Repairing →1. P1: if wake&0x40→8; if dist > BuildDistance+footprints → AttachBuildFootprintMarker + deadline Rand(30)+30 |0xe8 →2 (re-approach); else DeactivateWeaponSlot(3)+StartBuilding(heading)→1. P2: WaitIfNotInBuildStance(flags=8). P3: if HP>=Max→1; if target moving (flags&0xc) StopBuilding+deadline15→0; else cloakHoldoff=tick+0x96; ApplyRepairHealProgress(worker,target,WorkerTime/30); nano Fx_SpawnStartTickEffect(...,6); deadline1|8→2. P4: speech Unit_repaired→5. Abort: no attach / flags&3!=1 → Repairs_unsuccessful.

name: MissionTick_RepairUnitNoMove
signature: uint MissionTick_RepairUnitNoMove(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: RepairUnitNoMove. Req: BUILDER; target Build%==0; worker ACTIVATION. P0: DeactivateWeaponSlot(3)→1; else→8. P1: if HP>=Max or target moving (flags&0xc)→1; else cloak+0x96; ApplyRepairHealProgress(worker,target,WorkerTime/30); nano FX type6; deadline1|8→2. P2: speech Unit_repaired→5. No approach/StartBuilding/WaitIfNotInBuildStance.

name: MissionTick_RepairPatrol
signature: uint MissionTick_RepairPatrol(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: RepairPatrol. Phase0: copy attach unit pos to order.nPos if set; Mission_EnqueueLinkedTick (same ping-pong as Patrol); ret1. Phase1: if wake&0xe0 ret6; AttachApproachRadiusGoal(nPos,r=0x10)+deadline 0x3c|state|=0xe0; if energy>=20% storage scan sight for damaged ally via RepairPatrol_CollectDamagedAllyFilter -> EnqueueRepair; else if resources low Map_PickRandomMetalGeoInRadius -> RECLAIM.

name: RepairPatrol_CollectDamagedAllyFilter
comment: Map_ForEachUnitInRadius callback for MissionTick_RepairPatrol. Collects ally units (not self) that are activated, damaged or under-construction, excluding owner-slot construction-state 5. Pushes into STL vector at this+8.

name: MissionTick_Standby
signature: uint MissionTick_Standby(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: STANDBY (table MissionOrder_Standby lookup Standby). Ground idle/defaultmission; twin of VTOL_Standby / Standby_Mine.  Phases:  0: require pMotion else ret7; ActivateWeaponSlot(3); dwStateFlags|=0x10000; deadline 1 →1  1: Unit_FindBestTargetIfFireAtWill (only if StandingFire FIRE_AT_WILL bits21:20==0x200000); if target && Unit_IssueAttackOrder(explicit=0) → ret5 (ATTACK HANDOFF, standby done).     Else flags|=0x10000; deadline=0x1e+RandMod(0x1e) → ret2 (re-poll). Else ret7.  vs Standby_Mine: requires dwFlags&0x20000000; on contact enqueues SELFDESTRUCT(nParam0=1) ret5. vs Park: hold footprint / air→VTOL_MOVE morph; no fire-at-will poll.

name: MissionTick_Standby_Mine
signature: uint MissionTick_Standby_Mine(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Standby_Mine mission tick (defaultmissiontype Standby_Mine). Table: MissionOrder_Standby_Mine @004fc701 — display "Standby", lookup "Standby_Mine", drawMask=0x10, bPad10=0x0f, dwDefaultOrderFlags=0x01020000. RET 0xc (3 args; wake unused). FUN_=0  Phases:  0: Require unit.dwFlags&0x20000000 (building/static). Unit_ActivateWeaponSlot(3),     stateFlags|=0x10000, deadline=1 → phase1.  1: Poll Unit_FindBestTargetIfFireAtWill (requires FIRE_AT_WILL 0x200000). If target &&     (target.dwFlags&3)==1 && (self.dwFlags&0x300000)!=0 → Construct(SELFDESTRUCT,nParam0=1),     MissionOrder_PrependToUnitQueue → return 5.     Else stateFlags|=0x10000, deadline=0x1e+RandMod(0x1e) → return 2 (re-poll). Else return 7.  nParam0=1 skips SD countdown → immediate detonate. Trigger range = UnitDef.nSightDistance (NOT nKamikazeDistance).

name: MissionTick_Park
signature: uint MissionTick_Park(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Park idle (MissionOrder_Park lookup Park). Not in Orders_Resolve. Phase0: no pMotion ret7. CANFLY (unitdef+0x241 bit11): copy XYZ, FindByName(VTOL_MOVE)+MergeFlags ret0 (morph). Else footprint AttachPointFx, dwStateFlags=0xe0 ret1. Phase1: wake&0x20 or pNext!=0 ret5; else SetDeadlineTicks(0x1e) ret0. vs BeCarried: Park=voluntary hold; BeCarried=forced while pCarrier set.

name: MissionTick_Follow_Ground
signature: uint MissionTick_Follow_Ground(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: FOLLOW_GROUND (string Follow_Ground; announce Guarding). Player CANGUARD / OrderIntent_Defend → this (ground) or VTOL_Follow. Table @004fc737.  Gates: no attach→ret5; pCarrier set→ret7; followee CANFLY→ret8. Phases:  0: Announce Guarding; ActivateWeaponSlot(3); nParam0=(fpSelf+fpTarget+2)*0x10; store random-angle offset in nPos as relative orbit →1  1: if followee.pLastAttacker hostile AND wake&0x10 AND NOT in pNoChaseCategory → Unit_IssueAttackOrder(attacker, explicit=1) → clear flags ret3 (ATTACK HANDOFF). On fail + fire-order set: per-slot BadTarget gate may Weapon_SetAimTargetUnit(attacker).     Else if followee damaged + BUILDER → Resolve Repair → PrependToUnitQueue ret3.     Else if followee head is MobileBuild/BuildingBuild (BUILDER+flags) → HelpBuild (or copy build mission) Prepend ret3.     Else AttachApproachRadiusGoal(followee+offset, r=nParam0/2); deadline 0x1e; flags|=0x18 ret2. Else ret7.

name: MissionTick_Ground_Pickup
signature: uint MissionTick_Ground_Pickup(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Ground transport load. Phases: 0 validate canload+size vs cargo footprint; 2 COB TransportPickup(unitId); 4 wait cargo.pCarrier set / attach beam; 5 done. nParam0=attempt counter (fail if >2). Requires UnitDef CANLOAD. Size: bTransportSize >= cargo.nFootprintX.

name: MissionTick_Ground_Unload
signature: uint MissionTick_Ground_Unload(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: Ground transport unload. Phases: 0 attach PathOrder to cargo via pCargoHead, COB TransportDrop(cargoId, dropXZ); 1 wait/move; 2 verify cargo.pCarrier==self then attach beam to order pos; 3 done. nParam0=attempt counter.

name: MissionTick_Teleport
signature: uint MissionTick_Teleport(UnitInstance * pUnit, MissionOrder * pOrder, uint dwWakeFlags)
comment: TELEPORT mission tick (table @ 004fc818; name "TELEPORT").  Order path: OrderIntent_Teleport (11) -> Orders_ResolveMissionNameFromIntent -> s_TELEPORT. UnitDef.teleporter -> UnitTypeFlags.TELEPORTER bit13.  Single phase; always ret 5 (complete). 1) AABB from self.nPos + UnitDef.nModelMin/Max {X,Y,Z}. 2) Scan all UnitInstance in g_GameState unit array; skip self. 3) If unit inside AABB: delta = (order.nPosX/Y/Z + unit.nPos) - self.nPos    (preserves offset from teleporter; teleporter itself is NOT moved). 4) Fx_EnqueueEvent3Args(&unit.nPosX, &delta, duration=0x1e, slot=5). 5) Unit_SetWorldPosAndRelink(unit, newXYZ, occupyLayer=1).  No COB scripts invoked.

name: AiPlan_CmdPlan
comment: FUN_=0 Cmd "plan" [any|easy|medium|hard]...: clear g_dwDiffGate_Active@00501774=0; for each arg i>=1: OR=1 if arg matches s_any OR tag for GameState.nAiDifficulty (0=s_easy,1=s_medium,2=s_hard). Gates subsequent weight/limit lines in same script stream. Registered flags=8 via AiPlan_RegisterPlanWeightLimitMetrics → MissionOrderTable_RegisterBuiltins.

name: AiPlan_DiffGateForceEnable
comment: Force g_dwDiffGate_Active=1 so weight/limit cmds apply without a preceding plan line. Used by UnitTbl_*AiWeightScripts parsers (FBI aAiWeight multiline).

name: AiPlan_ApplyWeightIfGated
comment: Algorithm:   Cmd weight <name|category> <pct>: if g_dwDiffGate_Active, OrFromNameOrUnit then ApplyAiWeightForCategoryMask on every side whose PlayerState.pAiBehavior!=0 (stride 0x14b). Sticky override when name resolved as unit-type.  Parameters:   pLine — File_TokenLine argv[1]=name/category, argv[2]=weight pct (atof).  Returns:   void  Note: Decompiler may fold aPlayers[i].pAiBehavior as aDisplayName+0x2b due to packed char[]; asm is PlayerState+0x74.

name: AiPlan_ApplyLimitIfGated
comment: Algorithm:   Cmd limit <name|category> <count>: if g_dwDiffGate_Active, OrFromNameOrUnit then ApplyAiLimitForCategoryMask on sides with nIsActive!=0 and bControllerType==2 (AI). Sticky when name is unit-type.  Parameters:   pLine — argv[1]=name/category, argv[2]=limit (atoi).  Returns:   void  Note: Decompiler may fold PlayerState fields via aName/aDisplayName char[] bases; asm uses +0 (nIsActive) and +0x73 (bControllerType), stride 0x14b.

name: UnitTbl_IsCountBelowAiLimit_SideU8
signature: bool UnitTbl_IsCountBelowAiLimit_SideU8(uint nSide, ushort wUnitDefIndex, int nCount)

name: AiPlan_RegisterPlanWeightLimitMetrics
comment: Register DiffGate AI plan cmds into sorted cmd registry (flags=8): "plan"→AiPlan_CmdPlan, "weight"→AiPlan_ApplyWeightIfGated, "limit"→AiPlan_ApplyLimitIfGated. Caller: MissionOrderTable_RegisterBuiltins.

name: Projectile_MarkOwnerNetDirtyFromDmgSplit
signature: void Projectile_MarkOwnerNetDirtyFromDmgSplit(Projectile * pProj, int nEnemyDmg, int nFriendlyDmg)
comment: Projectile_MarkOwnerNetDirtyFromDmgSplit(pProj, nEnemyDmg, nFriendlyDmg).  If pOwnerUnit non-null:   nEnemyDmg > 2*nFriendlyDmg → Unit.wNetDirtyFlags hi |= 0x40   else → hi |= 0x20 Callers: Weapon_DetonateOrImpact (single-hit split); Weapon_ApplyAreaDamageAndBroadcast (accumulated enemy vs same-owner totals). Was: Projectile_MarkOwnerNetDirtyFromHitSplit / Unit_SetStatusFlagsByHpRatio.

name: Unit_RetargetAttack
comment: Retarget attack / weapon aim after notify.  Gate new Attack order: require noChaseCategory bit CLEAR and wpri BadTarget bit CLEAR for target.wUnitDefIndex (masks @ UnitDef+0x23d / +0x231).  Per weapon slot 0..2 (when dwFlags&0x300000): if slot armed (bFlags&2|&0x10), in range, and not COMMANDFIRE: if current aim missing/out-of-range OR (&pWpriBadTargetCategory)[slot] bit SET for current aim → Weapon_SetAimTargetUnit(newTarget). Bit test: mask->aAdwBits[idx>>5] & (1<<(idx&0x1f)).

name: Ai_FindNearestEnemyUnit
signature: undefined Ai_FindNearestEnemyUnit(AiBehaviorController * pController, int nPosX, int nPosY, int nPosZ)
comment: Nearest enemy UnitInstance* for AI (skip allies). Filters: ALIVE 0x10000000; (dwFlags&3)!=2; !(dwFlags&0x8000); !CLOAKED (bActivateFlags bit2). 0x8000 is AI exclusion distinct from cloak; compare Ai_RebuildUnitTblLists. Does NOT walk UnitTbl lists — scans all player unit arrays.

name: Ai_CtorBehaviorSlot
comment: AiBehaviorSlot base ctor (size 0x14). Sets pController, pSquadGroup, dwNextTick=0, ppVtable=AiBehaviorSlot_vftable, dwPlayerSlotIndex=controller.bSlotIndex (player index, not behavior-group index). Subclass ctors duplicate this then swap vtbl. Called from Ai_CtorBehaviorController for Base slot; others inline same init. Vtbl[0]=Tick, vtbl[1]=ScalarDtor. FUN_=0

name: Ai_TickBaseBehaviorSlot
comment: Base behavior Tick (vtbl[0]). Nop — group 5 holds factories/bases; no periodic orders. dwNextTick never advanced so would spam if non-null, but Tick returns immediately. FUN_=0

name: Ai_DtorBaseBehaviorSlot
comment: Scalar deleting dtor (vtbl[1]). Downgrade to AiBehaviorSlot_vftable; if (flags&1) Mem_Free. FUN_=0

name: Ai_TryGetBaseBuildOrScoutCentroid
comment: Dead helper: no xrefs. Same Base→Build→Scout centroid cascade as inlined in Ai_TickAssaultBehaviorSlot.

name: Ai_GetSquadAveragePosition
comment: Average squad world XYZ from high-words of unit nPos* (<<16). Returns 0 if empty, else 1 and writes int[3] outs. Used by Assault gather/attack, Escort follow, SquadScout enemy seek. FUN_=0

name: Ai_CountSquadUnitsNearPoint
comment: Count squad units near XYZ. Iterate this->+8 unit-range [begin+0x67..end+0x6b] stride 0x118; match field+0xac == range[1]; XZ (+0x6a,+0x72) within distSq of *pXYZ. Callees: __allmul/__allshr. DEAD — no CALL/data xrefs (likely link leftover; twin logic may be inlined near Ai_GetSquadAveragePosition / Ai_RebalanceAssaultGroupByCentroid).

name: Ai_RebalanceAssaultGroupByCentroid
comment: Rebalance assault↔escort peer groups by centroid distance. If either group empty: pull units from peer within nDistSqThresh into this (via Unit_SetPlayerGroupSlot). Else: move units farther than thresh from this centroid into peer group. Called at start of Ai_TickAssaultBehaviorSlot (slot2↔3, slot6↔7). FUN_=0

name: Ai_TickAssaultBehaviorSlot
comment: Assault slot tick every 300 frames.  RebalanceAssaultGroupByCentroid(peer, distSq). If empty: return. If count<=min OR (count<max && !seekEnemy): gather Move toward Base/Build/Scout centroid (slots 5,1,4); seekEnemy=0. Else: seekEnemy=1; Attack nearest enemy from own centroid via FindNearestEnemyUnit.  Slot2: peer=3 dist=0x4e20 min=3 max=6. Slot6: peer=7 dist=0xc350 min=3 max=6.

name: Ai_CtorAssaultBehaviorSlot
signature: void Ai_CtorAssaultBehaviorSlot(AiBehaviorController * pController, PlayerSquadGroup * pSquadGroup, int nPeerSlotIndex, int nRebalanceDistSqThresh)
comment: Assault slot ctor (size 0x28). Live from Ai_CtorBehaviorController (slots 2 and 6). Sets peer index, rebalance distSq, nMinGroupSize=3, nMaxGroupSize=6, nSeekEnemy=0; vtbl=AiAssaultBehaviorSlot_vftable. FUN_=0

name: Ai_DtorAssaultBehaviorSlot
comment: Scalar deleting dtor (vtbl[1]). Downgrade to AiBehaviorSlot_vftable; if (flags&1) Mem_Free. FUN_=0

name: Ai_CtorEscortBehaviorSlot
signature: void Ai_CtorEscortBehaviorSlot(AiBehaviorController * pController, PlayerSquadGroup * pSquadGroup, int nLinkedSlotIndex)

comment: A* neighbor expansion into open set.  Algorithm:   newDir=(parentCell.bIncomingDir+nTurnBias)&7; neighbor=parentXZ+DirDelta[newDir].   If out of bounds or CLOSED: return.   Walkable=IsCellWalkable; if 0 and !(flags&8): flags|=3 blocked, return.   Unvisited (flags&3==0): h=PathOrder vfunc+0x1c(x,z)*nHeuristicScale>>16; flags|=(h<=nRaycastMinH)?5:1; store dir;     step=(walkable<1)?0:0x1E; g=parent.g+aTurnCost[turn]+aDirCost[dir]+step; if turn!=0 && depth<5: g+=0x4B; f=g+h; push heap.   Open (flags&3==1): if cheaper g, update g/f/depth/dir and sift-up.   Tables (BeginPath): aTurnCost={0,0x28,0x3C,0x50,0x64,0x50,0x3C,0x28}; aDirCost even=0x10 odd=0x16.  Parameters:   this — AiSearch*   pParent — PathHeapNodeSlice* (Tick stack copy: cell/g/f/step/depth, no heapIndex)   pCellState — PathCellState* of parent cell   nTurnBias — turn delta mod 8 (0=straight)  Returns:   void (RET 0xC)

name: AiSearch_StepPopExpand
comment: A* open-set step: pop heap head, expand neighbors. If nHoldPoppedSlot: free prior open head into free-list + HeapSiftDown; snapshot top PathHeapNodeSlice; mark hold; if cell flags&4 set dwGoalFoundCellXZ and return 1; else set flags=2 and ExpandNeighbor for turnBias in [-nTurnExpandRange..+nTurnExpandRange]. Callees: AiSearch_HeapSiftDown, AiSearch_ExpandNeighbor. DEAD — no CALL/data xrefs (between ExpandNeighbor / ReconstructPath; likely inlined in search loop).

name: AiSearch_ReconstructPath
comment: AiSearch_ReconstructPath — walk parent dirs from goal→start, corner-compress, emit PathGoal waypoints.  Algorithm: 1. Start at dwGoalFoundCellXZ; follow PathCellState.bIncomingDir via g_abAiSearch_DirDeltaX/Z until start. 2. On direction change, push cell into ring[64] (corner compression). 3. Push start cell; clamp count≤0x40. 4. Convert cell→packed world short XZ: ((cell*2)+footprint)*8 using pMoveInfo footprint. 5. PathGoal_SetWaypoints(pPathGoal, worldXZ, count).  Params:   this — AiSearch*  Returns: void  Called when A* finds goal (Tick / StepPopExpand).

name: AiSearch_RaycastTowardGoal
comment: AiSearch_RaycastTowardGoal — seed raycast corridor toward nearest goal before A* expand.  Algorithm: 1. Heuristic at start via PathOrder vtbl[+0x1c]*nHeuristicScale>>16; require start passable. 2. March octant steps toward nearest goal; MarkCellTouched; set bIncomingDir + bFlags|8 (corridor). 3. On blocked: fan-search alternate dirs (±) until line-of-sight progress or loop; track min heuristic along corridor. 4. Abort (return 0) if hit goal-flag cell (&4) unexpectedly mid-corridor.  Params:   this — AiSearch* (__fastcall)  Returns: int best heuristic seen along corridor (0 if failed early)  Dirs: g_abAiSearch_DirDeltaX/Z octants 0..7.

name: AiSearch_BeginPath
comment: Start A* for unit: AcquirePathLock; load turn/dir cost tables; InitMapGrid; PathOrder vtbl+0x18 fills goal cells (flag|4); pick nearest goal cell; heuristic=vfunc+0x1c*scale>>16; RaycastTowardGoal; seed open heap with start PathHeapNode (g=0,f=h,depth=100); nTurnExpandRange=4. Fail: AddFlags 0x100/0x200, SetWaypoints(null,0), ReleasePathLock.

name: AiSearch_Ctor
comment: AiSearch ctor (__fastcall this). Size 0xC9. Called only from AiSearch_CreateGlobal → g_GameState->pAiSearch.  Algorithm: 1. Zero heap/pool (pNodePool/ppOpenHeap=0; nFreeListHead=-1; counts/hold=0). 2. nGridW/H from GameState map tiles; nGridCellCount=(W*H+7)&~7; alloc pCellStates[count]*4. 3. Alloc pTouchedBitmap ((count+255)>>8) dwords tagged "AISearch touched mapentries"; fill 0xFF then ClearTouchedCells. 4. Defaults: nBudgetDivisor=0x535; nBaseBudget=0x18000; nWorkSpent=0; bPlayerCursor=0; nHeuristicScale=0; pActiveUnit=0. 5. For player i=0..9: g_anAiSearch_PlayerBudgetCap[i]=nBaseBudget; aPlayerBudget[i]=0; apPlayerUnitCursor[i]=aPlayers[i].pUnitRangeStart.  Params: this — AiSearch* Returns: this FUN_=0

Callers: Unit_CreateFromDefId @004860b2; Unit_ApplyUnitPosePacket9 @004862ca.  bMetal seed: Map_LoadTnt fills all cells from MapInfo.nSurfaceMetal (OTA SurfaceMetal)   when nSurfaceMetal>=0 AND TNT version>=0x2000; else 0. Then Map_StampIndestructibleFeatureMetal overwrites footprint of FEATURE_INDESTRUCTIBLE   features with flMetal!=0 via __ftol(flMetal). Persist: GameSave_Save/LoadMetalPlotmap (section Metal / blob Plotmap).  Income: Player_AccumulateUnitResourceRates — if building(0x20000000)+ACTIVATION+   energyUsePaid(!stall) && flExtractsMetal>0: flMetalMake += flExtractMetalRate   (AI ctrl==2: easy*0.5 med*0.7). No ACTIVATION / build% / pScript-null gate (asm calls UnitScript_Call on unit+0x9a directly). comment: Sim stage 9 (Game_RunSimulationStep after wind). FUN_=0  SCHEDULE (dwGameTick>=NextSchedule):   Active=1; End=now+Duration; NextSchedule=End+ScheduleGap; NextSpawn=now   OriginTilePacked = rand tile (W/H via Rand15/0x8000)   AimTilePacked = Origin + (rand*30/0x8000-15, rand*10/0x8000-15)   If !Enabled → Active=0 (schedule still advanced)  SPAWN while Active && tick>=NextSpawn:   NextSpawn = now+SpawnInterval   velXZ = (Origin-Aim)*0x100000/0x5a; velY=-0xf0000   magnitude = (Rand15*SpawnMagnitude/0x8000)<<16; heading=Rand15*0x10000/0x8000   spawnPos = Aim*0x100000 - MulSin/Cos(heading,mag); Y = velY*-0x5a   Weapon_SpawnProjectile(g_pMeteorWeapon, pos, vel, bBroadcast=1)   Clear Active at EndTick.  CONFIG (Meteor_ApplyConfigToGlobals from OTA/MeteorConfig):   Radius→SpawnMagnitude; Density→Interval=ftol(30/density)   Duration→ShowerDuration=ftol(dur*30); Interval→ScheduleGap=ftol(int*30)  IMPACT: Projectile METEOR path (no wind) → collision → DetonateOrImpact. Net: spawn broadcasts Pkt 0x0D. Cheat: Cmd_SetMeteor → ForceStart/Enable/Disable. Save: GameSave_Save/LoadMeteor (Origin_*=Aim; Target_*=Origin — swapped keys).

name: UnitMotion_ApplyClampedTurnDelta
comment: DEAD — no CALL/DATA xrefs. thiscall UnitMotion: clamp turn delta to ±UnitDef.maxTurn(+0x1ba); store this+0x24; add into unit heading(+0x66); unit+0x110|=0x10000. Zero delta clears this+0x24. Neighbors: UnitMotion_UpdateVelocityFromHeading / UpdateSeekHeadingVelocity.

name: UnitMotion_UpdateVelocityFromHeading
comment: UnitMotion_UpdateVelocityFromHeading — ground velocity from heading + underwater half-speed.  Algorithm: 1. nSpeed += nAccelOrBrake; clamp >= 0. 2. nBankLutIdx = clamp(pUnit->nBank >> 11, -5..5). 3. dwMaxSpeed = (g_abSlopeSpeedFactor[nBankLutIdx] << 16) * pDef->nMaxVelocity / 0x640000. 4. If (nPosY>>16) < bSeaLevel AND !(FLOATER|CANHOVER=0x81000): dwMaxSpeed >>= 1. 5. Clamp nSpeed to dwMaxSpeed. 6. nVelX/Z = -Sin/Cos(wHeading)*nSpeed; nVelY=0.  Params:   this — UnitMotion*   pUnit — UnitInstance*   nAccelOrBrake — delta applied to nSpeed this tick  Returns: void

name: UnitMotion_UpdateSeekHeadingVelocity
comment: Ground seek physics: heading toward PathGoal; clamp delta by UnitDef.wTurnRate (+0x1ba); accel/brake from UnitDef.nAcceleration (+0x19e) / nBrakeRate (+0x19a); UnitMotion_UpdateVelocityFromHeading clamps speed by UnitDef.nMaxVelocity (+0x192).  Does NOT read UnitMotion.pMoveInfo / MoveInfo fields. MoveInfo is wired at UnitMotion_CtorGoalByUnitFlags from UnitDef.pMovementClass (+0x1b6) for AiSearch path-lock/passability only.  Indirect: UnitDef_LoadFbiProperties copies MoveInfo FootPrint/water/slope into UnitDef; nScaledMaxVelocity=(maxvel<<16)/((bMaxSlope+1)<<16) — not sampled here.

name: UnitMotion_ApplyDragAndComputeAim
comment: Fly aim helper. Decay nDragVelXYZ *= 0xf333/2^16 (~0.95); add pImpulseXYZ. Rotate drag-XZ by unit heading (Math_Rotate2DPoint). Pitch = Atan2(BankScale * -dragLocalX >>16, gravity/0xCCD); Bank  = Atan2(PitchScale * -dragLocalX >>16, gravity/0xCCD). Called from UpdateFlyPhysics (post-accel impulse) and SetActivateMode(nMode==1, zero impulse). Does not modify nVel*/nSpeed.

name: UnitMotion_SetActivateMode
comment: Set occupy/activate layer (bOccupyFlags bits0-1). nMode==1: zero vel/speed, ApplyDragAndComputeAim(0), Unit_SetActivateState(ACTIVATION,0). else: SetActivateState(ACTIVATION,1). Writes bits0-1 = nMode (typically 1=landed/deact, 2=fly/act). FlyPhysics only runs when (bOccupyFlags&3)==2. Callers: VTOL/air MissionTicks + PathGoal_PackedPos_DeserializeNetUnitState. FUN_=0

name: UnitMotion_UpdateFlyPhysics
comment: CANFLY (UnitDef+0x241 bit11) physics. If (bFlags&3)!=2: zero vel/speed/headingDelta and return. Else: PathGoal.vtbl+0x10 fill target; damp vel by (0x10000 - (UnitDef+0x19e<<16)/MaxVelocity(+0x192)); clamp horizontal speed to UnitDef+0x19a; pitch/heading toward target (turnrate +0x1ba); apply accel toward goal; UnitMotion_ApplyDragAndComputeAim.  Does NOT read UnitMotion.pMoveInfo. MoveInfo used only via ctor wiring for pathfinding.

name: UnitMotion_ApplyDeltaAndRelink
comment: Apply UnitMotion vel to UnitInstance pos; stamp dwLastMoveTick on any XYZ/layer change.  Carrier (pCarrier!=0):   Piece world pos (+sea/waterline clamp if UnitDef bit19); Unit_SetWorldPosAndRelink(..., bOccupyFlags&3);   piece angles → pitch/heading/bank; copy carrier pMotion vel/speed (or zero); clear unit flag bit16; return.  Free unit:   newPos = pos + nVel*; layer = bOccupyFlags&3.   No change → return.   Same map-cell + same layer: write nPos*; set unit.dwFlags bit16 (0x10000); return.   Cross-cell: if local ctrl (owner active && controller 1|2): Map_CanPlaceUnitFootprint → bOccupyFlags bit2 = !canPlace.   If bit2 blocked: clamp XYZ into current footprint cell ±0x7ffff; if nSpeed>MaxVelocity/2 then nSpeed=Max/2 and rebuild nVel from heading; write pos; set bit16; return (no relink).   Else: ClearFootprintFromMap; write pos+dwMapCellXZ; pack layer into unit.dwFlags&3; LinkToSpatialGrid; Los_UpdateUnitFromPosition; set bit16.  Velocity path only — does not touch pMoveInfo / dwPathLockStamp (those are MoveInfo_Acquire/ReleasePathLock + Unit_InvalidatePassabilityRects). FUN_=0

name: UnitMotion_NotifyScriptMoving
comment: Move-rate → UnitInstance.dwFlags bits2–3 (0xC) + Cob StartMoving/StopMoving/MoveRateN.  uRate:   0 if (bOccupyFlags&4) OR cargo *(unit+0x86)!=0 OR (nSpeed==0 && nHeadingDelta==0)   else 1 if nSpeed <= UnitDef.nMoveRate1(+0x1AE)        2 if nSpeed <= UnitDef.nMoveRate2(+0x1B2) else 3. If uRate == (dwFlags>>2)&3: return. uRate==0 → StopMoving; else if (dwFlags&0xC)==0 → StartMoving; then MoveRate1/2/3. Pack: dwFlags = (uRate<<2) | (dwFlags & ~0xC). FUN_=0

Bounds-check nPieceIndex against nPieceCount; else (0,0,0). 3. Start at piece offset = model nX/Y/ZFromParent + runtime nMoveX/Y/Z. 4. Walk pParent chain: accumulate parent turn angles; root parent adds unit pitch/bank/heading; Math_RotatePointByAngles; then add parent model+move offsets. 5. Write out (X, Y, -Z) — Z flipped to engine world convention. comment: Per-unit CursorMode for OrderIntent. FUN_=0  Preamble: unitOwner->aAllyFlags[hoverOwner->bSlotIndex]: 0→enemy, nonzero→ally. *unit==0 means !pMotion. Opaque returns: Load/Pickup=(~CANFLY>>11&1|2)<<2; Unload=(-CANLOAD&0xfa)+Normal; Repair=(-can&0xf3)+Normal; Patrol=(-CANPATROL&0xf4)+Normal; Stop-default=(-CANMOVE&0xfb)+Normal; Attack-hover=(-inRange&0xfe)+TooFar.  Stop (iface1): Select if own finished (flags&0x20, build%=0, holdoff=0, !carrier|carrier.flags&0x40000000); else enemy→Red, ally→Green; CANRESURRECT+mapped FEATURE_RECLAIMABLE→Green; CANRECLAMATE+same→Green; else Normal. Stop (iface0): CANATTACK+enemy→rewrite Attack; CANRECLAMATE+enemy→rewrite Reclaim; else repair (build%>0)→Repair; Select own finished; CANRESURRECT+feature→Revive; CANRECLAMATE+feature→Reclamate; else CANMOVE?Move:Normal. Attack: CANATTACK+pWeapon1.DROPPED→AirStrike; !CANATTACK→Normal; pMotion→Attack; hover→inRange?Attack:TooFar; ground→!inRange|TOAIRWEAPON→TooFar else Attack. Blast: !CANDGUN→Normal; stockpile range vs weapon → Attack|TooFar. Unload: CANLOAD?Unload:Normal. Load: CanLoad→Pickup(CANFLY)|Load. Defend: CANGUARD+ally + !(hover.CANFLY unless self.CANFLY)→Defend else Normal. Repair: CanRepair?Repair:Normal. Patrol: CANPATROL?Patrol:Normal. Teleport→Teleport. Reclaim: CANRECLAMATE+feature|CanReclaim→Reclamate. Capture: CANCAPTURE+hover+diff owner→Capture. Build: pBuildOptions&&pMotion→FindSite. StopAlt/default→Normal. Caller takes MIN over selection.

Status callers: 1=kick (Reject dlg / PLAYER kick / DP DESTROY), 2=PREVMENU leave, 3=game closed (DP), 4=bad password, 5=full, 6=lost connection/timeout REJECT, 7=missing unit, 8=newer version, 9=kick watchers on START / no watching, 0xA=creator left, 0xB=force-remove AI under deathmatch (wGameOptFlags&0x1800==0x1000). Broadcasts Net_BroadcastGuaranteed(size6) then often Lobby_RemovePlayerByNetId (only if prior bLobbyStatusCode==0 and ctrl gates). Also invoked from Net_ProcessIncomingPackets case 0x1B (apply inbound status).

Table: g_NetPacketSizeTable[5]=0x41 flags=7; FP stub Net_PacketTableStub_Type5_Chat_Reject returns -1 (live RX is inline case 5 in Net_ProcessIncomingPackets).  SEND MODES (bChatSendMode @+0x2bf0), unless text[0]=='+' OR mode==0 → Net_BroadcastGuaranteed:   1 allies: remote ctrl==3 AND local ally-matrix[local][slot]!=0 → Net_SendPacketToPlayer   2 enemies: remote ctrl==3 AND ally-matrix[local][slot]==0 → SendToPlayer   3 selected: aChatSelectedPlayers[slot]!=0 AND netId!=0 → SendToPlayer '+' prefix always forces broadcast (all).

name: Net_HandleLatencyPacket
comment: Pkt 0x02 Latency probe — NetPkt_Latency size 0x0D. Live dispatch: Net_ProcessIncomingPackets case 2 (not FP table). FP stub: Net_Latency_FpTableReject returns -1; InitPacketTypeTable size=0xD flags=7 (bits1|2|4 = lobby|loading|battle).  LAYOUT (NetPkt_Latency):   +00 u8  bType=2   +01 u32 dwSendTick          GetTickCount at ORIGINATOR send   +05 u32 dwEchoTick          0=REQUEST; echoer stamps GetTickCount → RESPONSE   +09 u32 dwTargetPlayerNetId originator nPlayerNetId (echo unicast dest)  RTT MODEL (one-way probe + echo):   1) Originator (ctrl 1|2 local human) every 0x3c scaled ticks:        Lobby_PeriodicPlayerSyncBroadcast builds REQUEST (echoTick=0),        HAPINET_guaranteepackets(0) → Net_BroadcastGuaranteed(self, pkt, 0xD) → restore.        Sole proven sender of size 0xD type2 (with echo path).   2) Any peer receiving REQUEST: stamp dwEchoTick; unguaranteed        Net_SendPacketToPlayer(dwRecvToId, dwTargetPlayerNetId, pkt, 0xD).   3) Originator receiving RESPONSE: require target slot (+09) active+ctrl1|2;        fromSlot = dwRecvFromId (echoer);        aPlayers[from].nLatencyRttMs = GetTickCount() - dwSendTick.        (echoTick itself unused in RTT math — marker only.)  DISPLAY / USE:   MultiLobby_UpdatePlayerListGui:     PING_%d gadget: only remote human rows (bControllerType==3 && SideData.bControllerType==1)       → Str_Itoa(nLatencyRttMs); else g_szPingNotAvailable="n/a".     Host (SideData.bHostFlags&1): track min of those RTTs; if min < wHostMinPingMs       ratchet-down SideData.wHostMinPingMs (+0x9F) → Lobby_UpdateGameInfoSession       (packed in session user dword via SideData+0x9D with wAllyWinFlags).

comment: Host loading start-pos assign + ShareVisionReady (pkts 0x15/0x1E/0x1F). Caller: Frontend_HandleStateLoading when bLoadingFlags bit2; success clears bit2, sets bit3. Phase B — gate: each active ctrl3 remote needs aShareVisionReady[i] AND aStartPosAssignAck[i]   (ack array = aShareVisionReady+11). Host type1|2 pre-marked ready in Loading init.  Phase C — if host playable: for slots with aStartPosAssignAck==0:   ctrl3 remote: Net_SendPacketToPlayer [0x1E][aStartPosShuffle[i]] size2     (from first ctrl1 netId → remote netId).   ctrl1|2 local: PlayerState.bStartPosIndex(+0x147)=shuffle[i]; ack=1.  Phase D — when gate OK: BroadcastGuaranteed [0x15] size1 to each ctrl1|2.  RECV (Net_ProcessIncomingPackets):   0x1E → bStartPosIndex=pkt[1]; reply [0x1F][netId] size5   0x1F → aStartPosAssignAck[slot]=1   0x15 → aShareVisionReady[from]=1 (if Loading bit2) MP spawn (Game_InitializeBattle provider3): FindStartPosCoordsById(..., bStartPosIndex). FUN_=0

name: Share_ApplyPlayerViewStatePacket
comment: Pkt 0x28 ViewState APPLY (+ optional share handshake). Gate: pFromPlayer!=NULL && !bViewStateDone. Stats copy skipped if any active human/net (ctrl 1|2) already has aShareVisionFlags[senderSlot]!=0. Else copy wire→PlayerState: kills/losses (u16), metal/energy amounts+storage, prod/cons/waste doubles (via f32). If pPacket->bShareFlag!=0:   for each local-capable peer (active, ctrl 1|2, !bViewStateDone):     peer.aShareVisionFlags[senderSlot]=1;     send NetPkt_ShareLosAck (0x29) size3:       [0]=0x29 [1]=1 [2]=(peer.aShareLosFlags[senderSlot]!=0);     if !VictoryConditions_EvalWinForProvider && !peer.aShareLosFlags[senderSlot]:       Net_SendPlayerViewStatePacket(peer, sender, bShareFlag=1). Recv 0x29 (Net_ProcessIncomingPackets @0045590e):   aShareLosFlags[from]=1; if pkt[2] aShareMappingFlags[from]=1. These flags gate Share_BroadcastPendingViewState; 0x28 does NOT merge live fog/camera. FUN_=0

Per SyncPlayerRecord: require FBI in pFbiChecksum*; if side field_0xa7/a8 "full" and pScriptChecksum* != param_2 → mismatch. Missing FBI → mismatch. param_2==0 (post-join MapC walk): skip script vector compare. Sets node+0x1a; Sync_RegisterFbiChecksumAndBroadcast.

name: Sync_TickPlayerChecksumExchange
comment: Net sync checksum exchange (pkt 0x1a) — DOMAIN: unit-definition file hashes only.  NOT checksummed: unit positions, HP, resources, orders, or live game state.  Per UnitDef key/value exchanged:   UnitDef+0x13e dwFbiChecksum  = Hash_ComputeSimpleChecksum(units/<name>.FBI)                                  optional override from units/<name>.OVR Compatability/%u   UnitDef+0x142 dwScriptChecksum = Unit_ComputeScriptChecksum:       XOR Hash(scripts/<name>.cob)       XOR Hash(each guis/<name>*.gui match)       XOR Hash(download/<name>.tdf) if present       XOR UnitDef+0x146 dwWeaponHashXor   UnitDef+0x146 dwWeaponHashXor = XOR of Weapons/*.tdf section hashes for       weapon1, weapon2, weapon3, explodeas, selfdestructas (TDF node+0x25)  Packet 0x1a subtypes (pPacket[1]):   0 server hello to peer   1 client: expected count = nUnitDefCount-1 (→ SyncPlayerRecord.dwExpectedChecksumCount)   2 client: FBI key @+6, script checksum @+10 (→ pFbiChecksum*/pScriptChecksum* vectors)   3 server broadcast SyncChecksumEntry fields   4 client progress/done count  SyncChecksumEntry (map node value, 0xE): dwFbiChecksum, dwScriptChecksum,   wUnitEnabled, wChecksumMatch, nMaxThisUnit. Ready when vector size == dwExpectedChecksumCount && dwPacketsSent == dwPacketsRecv.

If def mismatch: synthesize local pkt9 + Unit_ApplyUnitPosePacket9(ownerSlot,&localPkt9). Then: nHitPoints u16; buildPct u8 → flBuildPercentLeft = u8*(1/255); may set dwFlags|=0x2000. activate via Unit_SetActivateState(on) then Unit_SetActivateState(~bits,0). u2 flags&3; transport bit → Unit_ApplyTransportAttachPacket (piece/carrier). else: read pos/orient; update footprint/LOS if cell or flags&3 changed; set dwFlags|=0x10000; if pMotion: read u32 → pMotion->nSpeed. EARLY OUT: MapInfo.nNoSeaLevelTrigger!=0 && bIsSeaCell && pHitUnit==NULL → mark dead; return (suppress water FX/dmg) 3. Camera_AccumulateShake(mag,mag,dur) 4. FX/SOUND:    - land OR unit-hit: SoundHit; if ENDSMOKE(0x400) → Fx_SpawnTypedEffectFlag0(pos,9); else Fx_SpawnWorldEffect(pExplosionSeq)    - pure water (sea && !pHitUnit): SoundWater + Fx_SpawnWorldEffect(pWaterExplosionSeq, waterFlag=1) 5. DAMAGE (skip if owner player controllerType==3):    - AoE<0x11 && pHitUnit!=NULL → Weapon_ApplyScaledDamageToTarget(scale=1.0); MarkOwnerNetDirtyFromDmgSplit(enemy/friendly)    - else → Weapon_ApplyAreaDamageAndBroadcast(pProj, &nPosX)  Other callers: UpdateAllActive (BURNBLOW/timer expire/seek miss); DetonateMatchingProjectile (pkt 0x0E); INTERCEPTOR chain; Unit_DetonateExplodeAsOrSelfDestruct.

UNITS (occupy then secondary; skip pOwnerUnit; dedup ≤20):   dist = AABB-closest-point length >> 16 (inline FSQRT+ftol)   if dist < radius:     scale = (dist==0) ? 1.0 : (1-edge)*(dist/radius-1)^2 + edge   // edge=flEdgeEffectiveness     dmg = Weapon_ApplyScaledDamageToTarget(pProj, unit, scale)     accumulate enemy vs same-owner totals  FEATURES (!UNITSONLY; dedup ≤64):   id 0xFFFE → resolve anim origin cell; require id < 0xFFFB   dist via FeatureAnim pos OR Map_WorldPosFromGridWithHeight; Math_Vec3LengthFtol if anim   if dist < radius → Feature_ApplyWeaponDamage(cell,x,y,pWeapon)  // full nDefaultDamage, no falloff  INTERCEPTOR (WeaponFlags bit30=0x40000000):   for each live (wFlags&2==0) other projectile with distSq < AoE^2:     Weapon_DetonateOrImpact(other, NULL)     Net_BroadcastGuaranteed pkt 0x0E size 0x0E for other then self (aimX/Y/Z + weapon.bIndex)  Finally: if pOwnerUnit → Projectile_MarkOwnerNetDirtyFromDmgSplit(enemyTotal, friendlyTotal). name: Projectile_UpdateCollision
comment: Projectile_UpdateCollision(pWeapon, pProj) — post-flight hit tests → Weapon_DetonateOrImpact.  ORDER (early return on unit hit): 1. HeightMap_GetCellFromWorldPos NULL → camera-unfollow if tracked; wFlags|=2 (dead); return 2. pInterceptedProjectile non-null: if distSq(pos,intercepted.pos) < AoE^2 → DetonateOrImpact(NULL) [no early return; continues] 3. nGroundHeightAvg = (bHeightMax+bHeightMin)/2 4. UNIT HIT primary: wOccupyingUnitId!=0 && enemy owner && nPosY < unit.posY+nModelMaxY → Detonate(pUnit); return 5. UNIT HIT secondary: wSecondaryUnitId!=0 && enemy && nModelMinY+posY <= nPosY <= nModelMaxY+posY → Detonate(pUnit); return 6. UNITSONLY (0x4000) → return (skip feature/ground/water) 7. FEATURE: resolve FeatureDef (id<0xFFFB direct; id==0xFFFE via anim-index cell redirect); if nPosY.hi < bHeight+bHeightMin AND tile (X>>4,Z>>4) != nLastFeatureTile* debounce → Detonate(NULL) 8. GROUND: nPosY.hi < bHeightMin: GROUNDBOUNCE(0x8000) → nVelY = -(nVelY>>2) return; else fallthrough detonate 9. Else (above ground min): WATERWEAPON → return; else if nPosY.hi < bSeaLevel && !MapInfo.nNoSeaLevelTrigger → water detonate 10. LAB detonate: Weapon_DetonateOrImpact(pProj, NULL)  Caller: Projectile_UpdateAllActive after integrate.

Else if pInterceptedProjectile → &intercepted->nPosX.   Else if pTargetUnit alive (dwFlags bit28) → &unit->nPosX.   Else → &nAimX.  Parameters:   this (Projectile*)  Returns:   int* world XYZ  Caller: Projectile_UpdateAllActive SELFPROP seek.

Else step by ±nTurnRate or snap if within rate.  Parameters:   pProj, pAimPos  Returns:   0 = BURNBLOW overshoot; 1 = ok  Caller: Projectile_UpdateAllActive SELFPROP seek (GUIDANCE or TWOPHASE phase).

name: Projectile_UpdateAllActive
comment: Algorithm:   Per-projectile flight (stride 0x6b).   wBurstRemaining==0 → flight dispatch:     PROPELLER: nPropellerSpin+=0x400.     SELFPROP: accel; seek if GUIDANCE or (TWOPHASE&&wFlags&0x30); expire BURNBLOW/phase2; UpdateCollision.     LINEOFSIGHT: linear; BEAMWEAPON trail; expire→wFlags|=2. METEOR: pos+=vel + spin; no wind.   wBurstRemaining!=0 (burst sequencer):     When tick >= dwSpawnTick+nBurstRate:       If nBurstRate>4 OR remaining odd: refresh parent nPos from owner weapon piece.       remaining--; dwSpawnTick+=nBurstRate; alloc clone (inline AllocSlot).       memcpy 0x6B from parent→clone; clone.dwSpawnTick=now; clone.wBurstRemaining=0. name: UnitScript_ExecSlot
comment: COB/UnitScript bytecode interpreter for one slot.  Opcode = word & 0x100FF000 (low bits = PUSH/POP operand kind). Slot dwStatus: high byte 0=idle, 0x01=RUNNING(0x1000000), 0x02=WAITING(0x2xxxxx). Wait subtype bits20..23 (mask 0xF00000):   0x1 → 0x2100000 WAIT_TURN (wake when aTurnSpeed[piece,axis]==0)   0x2 → 0x2200000 WAIT_MOVE (wake when aMoveSpeed[piece,axis]==0)   0x4 → 0x2400000 SLEEP (nSleepRemain -= nDelta; wake when <=0)   0x8 → 0x2800000 CALL_SCRIPT (wake only when child RETURN/SIGNAL) Wake path @004b0dbd: if WAITING, resolve subtype; on done set RUNNING then fall into exec loop. Only RUNNING (0x1000000) executes opcodes; loop while bContinue.  === CONTROL-FLOW / WAIT === UnitScriptSlot: +0 dwStatus,+4 nPC,+8 nStackTop,+0xC nSleepRemain,   +0x10 nWaitPiece,+0x14 nWaitAxis,+0x18 nChildSlot,+0x1C dwSignalMask,   +0x20 pCallback,+0x24 aStack[32]. 8 slots; PrepareSlot @004b08c0.  0x10011000 WAIT_FOR_TURN  imm piece,axis; status=0x2100000; store wait; PC+3; stop 0x10012000 WAIT_FOR_MOVE  imm piece,axis; status=0x2200000; store wait; PC+3; stop 0x10013000 SLEEP          pop ms; status=0x2400000;                           nSleepRemain=(nTickRate*ms)/1000; PC+1; stop 0x10061000 START_SCRIPT   imm funcIdx,argN; PrepareSlot; copy argN stack→child;                           child.dwSignalMask=parent; PC+3; continue (no wait) 0x10062000 CALL_SCRIPT    imm funcIdx,argN; PrepareSlot; copy args; child mask;                           nChildSlot=slot|-1; status=0x2800000; PC+3; stop 0x10063000 DISCARD_ARGS   imm[1] unread; pop imm[2] into unused locals; PC+3 0x10064000 JUMP           PC = imm[1] (absolute) 0x10065000 RETURN         pop ret→pCallback[0] if set; status=0; nActiveSlots--;                           wake CALL waiters whose nChildSlot==thisSlot → RUNNING; stop 0x10066000 JUMP_IF_FALSE  pop cond; if 0: PC=imm[1] else PC+2 0x10067000 SIGNAL         pop bits; kill matching masks; wake CALL parents; PC+1 0x10068000 SET_SIGNAL_MASK pop → dwSignalMask; PC+1  === EMIT_SFX / EXPLODE / CREATE / transport === (vtable g_pUnitScriptContext_vtable @004fd698) NO Cob CREATE_UNIT opcode in ExecSlot. Gaps 0x10072000..0x10081000 → unknown kill. UnitInstance spawn = engine Unit_CreateFromDefId → UnitScript_Create (CallNamed "Create").  0x10009000 EXPLODE_LEGACY  imm piece; pop2 (unused); vt+0x28 ExplodeLegacyNoop; PC+2 0x1000A000 PLAY_SOUND      imm soundId; vt+0x2c PlaySoundNoop (empty); PC+2 0x1000F000 EMIT_SFX        imm piece; pop sfxId; vt+0x30 EmitSfx(piece,sfxId); PC+2                            LOS→SyncAnimTree; sfxId&0x100 attach-origin else piece matrix;                            IDs 0..5,0x101..0x103 → Fx_*; else no-op                            jmp g_apfnUnitScript_EmitSfx_JumpTable @00481128 (cases 0..5) 0x10022000 CREATE_LOCAL    nStackTop++; PC+1  (STACK_ALLOC; not unit create) 0x10071000 EXPLODE         imm piece; pop flags; vt+0x34 ExplodePiece(piece,flags); PC+2                            !(flags&0x20): debris via ClonePieceIntoDebrisPool;                              flags&1 → packed|=4 shatter→Fx_SpawnDebrisFromUnitPiece                            flags&0x3f00: bitmap Fx_SpawnWorldEffect at piece world pos                              0x100/200/400/800/1000/2000 → Explosion/2/3/4/5/Nuke1 seq 0x10083000 ATTACH_UNIT     pop unitId,piece,motionLow2; vt+0x38 AttachUnit; PC+1                            → Unit_SendTransportAttachPacket(cargo,self,piece,motion) pkt 0x0A 0x10084000 DROP_UNIT       pop unitId; vt+0x3c DropUnit; PC+1                            if carrier==self && footprint ok:                            SendTransportAttachPacket(unit,0,0xFF,1) detach  === GET / SET unit-value === 0x10042000 GET_UNIT_VALUE → vt+0x44 UnitScript_GetUnitValue(id,0,0,0,0) 0x10043000 GET            → vt+0x44 UnitScript_GetUnitValue(id,p1,p2,p3,p4) 0x10044000 GET1           → vt+0x48 UnitScript_Get1_IsTransportingUnitId 0x10045000 GET0           → vt+0x4c UnitScript_Get0_CarrierUnitId 0x10082000 SET            → vt+0x40 UnitScript_SetUnitValue(id,value) GET dense 1..20: g_apfnCob_GetUnitValue_JmpTable @00480ac4 (GetUnitValue plate). SET sparse: g_abCob_SetUnitValue_SparseIdx @00480c18 → g_apfnCob_SetUnitValue_JmpTable @00480bfc;   settable 1,5,6,18,19,20; else dirty-only wNetDirtyFlags|=4.  === MOVE/TURN/SPIN === 0x10001000..04000 MOVE/TURN/SPIN/STOP_SPIN; 0xB000/0xC000 *_NOW Flat idx=axis+piece*0x13; speeds/=nTickRate.  Unknown opcode → status=0, nActiveSlots--. FUN_=0.

name: UnitScript_AdvancePieceAnims
comment: Advance CobPieceAnimState MOVE/TURN/SPIN per tick. Caller: UnitScript_TickSlotsAndAnim (after ExecSlot); also CallNamed/InvokeByIndex with nDelta=0 (no pose step). Gate: nDelta!=0 && nAnimDirty!=0; clears nAnimDirty then re-sets if any piece still dirty.  Per piece (size 0x4C) if nDirty: clear nDirty; for axis 0..2:   MOVE: if aMoveSpeed[ax]: cur=GetPieceMove+ nDelta*speed; clamp to aMoveTarget; SetPieceMove; else clear speed keep dirty.   SPIN ramp: if aSpinAccel[ax]: aTurnSpeed += aSpinAccel; clamp toward aSpinSpeed; clear accel at target.   TURN/SPIN apply: if aTurnSpeed[ax]: ang=GetPieceTurn+nDelta*speed (&0xffff);     aTurnTarget==-1 (SPIN): keep dirty (infinite).     else approach target with 16-bit wrap dist; clear speed on arrive.     SetPieceTurn(ang).   If any axis still active: nDirty=1, nAnimDirty=1.  Rates stored as script_rate/nTickRate (see ExecSlot MOVE/TURN/SPIN). Axes 0..2 = ObjectPiece X/Y/Z (nMoveX.. / nTurnX..). Renamed from UnitScript_Run. FUN_=0.
